# Welcome

A disposable test vault for Markdown Workbench. Copy this folder somewhere
else before testing; never test in a real vault. Each note covers one area of
`docs/MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md`.

- [[Core]]: typing, saving, undo, folding and formatting
- [[Formatting]]: inline syntax, headings, quotes and lists
- [[Links]]: wikilinks, Markdown links, external links and embeds
- [[Properties]]: every property type
- [[Tables]]: the table editor
- [[Callouts]], [[Math]], [[Diagrams]], [[Code]]
- [[Footnotes]], [[Tasks]], [[Tags]]
- [[Embeds]]: images, media, PDF and note embeds
- [[Videos]]: YouTube and Bilibili cards
- [[Search]]: embedded query blocks
- [[notes/Project plan|Project plan]] and [[Duplicate]] (two notes share that name)
